title: Sawsan Alqahtani
text:
I am an AI researcher and Assistant Professor at Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University (PNU), with research interests spanning natural language processing, speech technologies, foundation models, trustworthy AI, and the adoption of AI in real-world domains.
My work bridges the development and evaluation of AI technologies with their practical application and organizational adoption. I am particularly interested in Arabic and multilingual AI, speech and language technologies, large language models, AI agents, responsible AI, and AI-enabled transformation.
I hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science from The George Washington University and have worked across academia and industry, including research and applied AI roles at Amazon and SDAIA.


I’m interested in connecting with students, researchers, and practitioners whose interests overlap with mine, particularly on research that combines strong technical foundations with meaningful real-world problems.
If you’re exploring a research idea or potential collaboration, feel free to reach out with a short introduction and the topic you’d like to explore.

title: Research
text:
My research focuses on language technologies, intelligent systems, trustworthy AI, and the adoption of AI in real-world settings.

For a complete list of publications, see my Google Scholar.





Natural Language Processing & Multilingual AI
My research focuses on Arabic and multilingual language technologies, with particular interest in morphology, tokenization, conversational AI, diacritic restoration, and language model evaluation.


Selected Recent Publications

NeurIPS 2025 Workshop
Injecting Domain Knowledge in Language Models for Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems
EMNLP 2022
Using Optimal Transport as an Alignment Objective for Fine-Tuning Multilingual Contextualized Embeddings
EMNLP 2021







Speech & Spoken Language Technologies
My research focuses on technologies for understanding, generating, and evaluating spoken language, with particular interest in speech recognition, text-to-speech, speech data, and the interaction between speech and language processing.


Selected Recent Publications


Data Augmentation for Speech-Based Diacritic Restoration
ANLP 2024

Foundation Models & Intelligent Systems
My research explores the development, adaptation, and evaluation of foundation models and intelligent systems, including LLMs, generative AI, and AI agents.

Trustworthy & Responsible AI
My research focuses on the reliability, safety, security, and responsible development of AI systems, with particular interest in red teaming, robustness, vulnerability assessment, and responsible AI evaluation.
